title.en: What the Bitumen outline cannot add to LZ-80 Diesel Concrete Pump

description.en: Section titles come from Bitumen; the LZ-80 Diesel Concrete Pump figures stay the printed ones. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai publishes LZ-80 Diesel Concrete Pump. The published table prints Engine (Diesel) 256 kW (Yuchai); Theoretical Output High pressure ≤ 65 m³/h; low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h; Pumping Pressure High pressure ≤ 35 MPa; low pressure ≤ 22 MPa; Hopper Capacity 0.6 m³; Conveying Distance 120 m; Delivery Height Consult factory standard; Max. Aggregate Size 6 cm and below; Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki double 140; Dimensions (L×W×H) 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m; Total Weight 6800 kg. Not printed, so left blank: cylinder bore, piston stroke, service life, a material grade number. The content photograph does not add a figure that the table omits.
